Eleanor M. Nesbitt

About the author

Eleanor Nesbitt's books tend to be about religion, especially on Sikh, Hindu and Quaker subjects. Examples are: Guru Nanak (co-authored with Gopinder Kaur), Hindu Children in Britain (co-authored with Robert Jackson), Sikhism A Very Short Introduction, and Open to New Light: Quakers and Other Faiths. Eleanor has taught in Naini Tal (India) and Coventry (UK), mainly at the University of Warwick, where she's now Professor Emerita.
